unit: one target root, one first candidate, per Skill
resolved_complete: Target root is removed across legal candidate inputs, no residual target branch; all original non-target defects are retained separately and not mislabeled as newly introduced.
changed_clear_semantics: Changes to a previously defined nondefective relation/model outside the target repair. Direct choices required to resolve a contradictory or impossible target are separately disclosed as scope changes even if this flag is false.

scope_changes.st-001-mutant: Private unavailable processing order replaced by input order; model restriction at the defective order rule.
scope_changes.st-004-mutant: Unlimited traversal replaced by length at most n; operation set restricted. Previously finite optima (nonpositive cycle sum) are retained.
scope_changes.st-025-base: Explicitly mixed single/double-way road model replaced by all-directed model. This exceeds merely adding missing per-road direction data; changed_clear_semantics=true.
scope_changes.st-026-base: Input n=1 removed. Numeric input domain changes even though no answer had been defined for that input.
scope_changes.st-034-base: Message budget increases from n-1 to ceil(log2(n!)); feasibility repair changes protocol resources.

specific_nondefective_change.original-st-011-mutant: Mixed tolerance changes nonzero acceptance, not only the undefined zero case. The legal witness is in its proof and enumeration.

report_both: Report target-root resolution and the stricter effective-without-new-error-or-changed-task rate, plus all numeric/model/protocol scope changes. A coherent author-approved candidate is not proof that the original intended design was preserved.
judge_kind: maintainer_model; not human or independent-model verification
